app_guard|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION api.app_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'api', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare o int; n int; lim numeric;
begin
  select ord into n from api.status where id=new.status_id;
  if tg_op='INSERT' then
    if n is distinct from 1 then raise exception 'новая заявка создаётся в статусе Черновик' using errcode='23514'; end if;
  elsif new.status_id is distinct from old.status_id then
    select ord into o from api.status where id=old.status_id;
    if not ((o=1 and n=2) or (o=2 and n=3) or (o=3 and n in (4,5))) then
      raise exception 'недопустимый переход статуса' using errcode='23514'; end if;
  end if;
  if n in (4,5) and coalesce(btrim(new.verdict),'')='' then
    raise exception 'нужно заключение эксперта' using errcode='23514'; end if;
  if n=4 then
    select funding_limit into lim from api.company where id=new.company_id;
    if lim is null or new.amount>lim then raise exception 'сумма превышает лимит компании' using errcode='23514'; end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
